hostCapabilityPolicy: The product imports PCR_INGRESS_METADATA_CONTRACT from Pi's loader-provided host module and fails during extension loading on stock 0.84.4. T12 is supported only on the exact patched host; publishable self-contained host distribution remains T52 scope.
stockProbeIsolationPolicy: The acceptance probe resolves the pnpm package symlink to a real package directory, copies it into a disposable root, reverses the patch only in that copy, and verifies that the repository host digest is unchanged.

identityPolicy.receipt: Provisional receipt identity is derived from the full capture cursor, exact raw SHA-256, source, timestamp, operation ID and injected occurrence nonce.
identityPolicy.transit: Patched Pi carries pcr.user-input-receipt.v1 as namespaced JSON-safe ingressMetadata keyed by the stable inputId; it never encodes correlation in user text, array adjacency, FIFO state or provider-visible message metadata.
identityPolicy.handled: Patched Pi emits input_result for every accepted or handled dispatch. A handled dispatch durably moves the receipt from pending to handled and cannot be linked by a successor input.
identityPolicy.turn: Final userTurnId is derived only from the sidecar-bearing Pi SessionMessageEntry's own stable ID after scanning the complete append-only entry set. Copied historical sidecars from a forked session are ignored unless their origin session matches the active cursor.

hardFailurePolicy: Predictable prompt preflight validation runs before durable capture. Capture or unsupported-input failures return a rejected input outcome. Any failure after capture but before host message ownership emits a strict input_result rejected terminal before rethrowing; terminal persistence failure is propagated rather than converted into success.
queueDropPolicy: Queued steer/followUp messages retain inputId, source and sidecar until delivery. clearQueue strictly persists every queue-cleared terminal before mutating either Pi queue; a terminal handler failure rejects clearQueue and leaves the queue available for retry.
providerPolicy: ingressMetadata is stored only on SessionMessageEntry and is never copied onto AgentMessage or provider context.
branchPolicy: Reconciliation scans SessionManager.getEntries() across active and inactive branches and binds by sidecar identity, not topology adjacency.
hostOwnershipPolicy: A host message ID is unique within workspace and session, independent of leaf, lineage or model cursor dimensions.
imagePolicy: Image-bearing inputs fail closed until attachment bytes have an exact durable envelope; images are never silently dropped.

sourcePolicy.tuiCompactionQueue: interactive call sites explicitly preserve authenticated-user
